% A report whose parts are read by \include from a subfolder: a chapter
% with a citation and a \nocite, a chapter that \includeonly leaves out,
% whose .aux LaTeX never writes, and a part two folders down with the
% bibliography, from a .bib named by a path in a subfolder.
\documentclass{report}
\includeonly{test-bibinclude/chapter,test-bibinclude/sub/refs}
\begin{document}
\include{test-bibinclude/chapter}
\include{test-bibinclude/omitted}
\include{test-bibinclude/sub/refs}
\end{document}
